metadata.title: Loading States & Error Handling - Consistent Patterns

story.iWant: loading states and error messages to follow consistent patterns (skeletons, boundaries, retry logic)
story.soThat: I understand what's happening and can recover from failures without frustration
story.tasks: - Task 1: Design & Document Loading & Error Patterns (AC: #1-10) - Task 2: Implement Skeleton Screen Component (AC: #1, #4, #10) - Task 3: Implement Error Boundary Components (AC: #2, #4, #8) - Task 4: Implement API Error Handling & Retry Logic (AC: #3, #4, #6) - Task 5: Implement Toast Notification System (AC: #3, #6) - Task 6: Implement Confirmation Dialogs (AC: #7) - Task 7: Implement Empty States (AC: #5, #4) - Task 8: Apply Loading States to Existing Pages (AC: #1, #10) - Task 9: Apply Error Boundaries to Pages (AC: #2, #4) - Task 10: Apply Error Handling to Forms (AC: #9) - Task 11: Apply Toast Notifications to Actions (AC: #3, #6) - Task 12: Documentation & Accessibility Audit (AC: #4) - Task 13: Component Tests for Loading & Error States (AC: #1-10) - Task 14: Integration with Existing Pages (AC: #1-10)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Consistent Loading State UI Components - Skeleton screens with min 200ms/max 5s timing, progress indicators, aria-busy announcements, prefers-reduced-motion respect, WCAG AA contrast
Error Boundary Components - React error catching at page/section/component levels, user-friendly messages, technical details in dev mode, retry buttons, graceful degradation
API Error Handling with Retry Logic - Network/4xx/5xx/timeout messages, exponential backoff for 429/503, max 3 retries, manual retry button, toast notifications
Accessibility of Loading & Error States - Immediate announcements, role=alert, aria-live, keyboard navigation, visible focus, clear messages, aria-busy management
Empty States - "No items found" messages with suggestions/CTA buttons, distinct from error states, screen reader announcements, examples for agents/history/logs
Toast Notifications - Success/Error/Info variants, 5s auto-dismiss, max 3 visible with queuing, top-right fixed position, aria-live=polite, descriptive messages
Confirmation Dialogs for Destructive Actions - Modal with title/description, Cancel default focus, Tab focus trapping, Esc key close, keyboard accessible buttons
Consistent Error Messages & Tone - User-focused language, actionable next steps, distinction between user/system/network errors, recovery actions included
Form Validation & Error Display - Inline errors next to fields, aria-describedby association, specific messages, red border/icon styling, error cleared on input, aria-invalid on fields
Data Loading Indicators in Tables & Lists - Skeleton rows during load, pagination state indicators, smooth transitions without page jumps, focus preserved, data-loaded announcements

constraints.constraint: Accessibility: All loading/error states must follow WCAG 2.1 AA standards from Story 34 (4.5:1 contrast for text, 3:1 for UI, visible focus indicators)
Skeleton Animation: Must respect prefers-reduced-motion media query - static skeleton (no shimmer) when user prefers reduced motion
Loading Timing: Min 200ms to avoid flicker, max 5s before timeout error. Skeleton should show during all data fetches
Error Boundary Scope: Page-level catches all page errors, section-level for card/panel errors, component-level for specific features. Ensures graceful degradation
Retry Logic: Max 3 automatic retries for transient errors (429, 503). Manual retry button available for all errors. Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s
Focus Management: Error messages and confirmation dialogs must trap focus and manage tab order. Escape key closes modals. Default focus on Cancel (safer)
Toast Stacking: Max 3 visible toasts, additional toasts queued. Auto-dismiss after 5s or manual close. Announced to screen readers (aria-live=polite for success/info, aria-live=assertive for error)
Form Validation: Client-side validation errors shown inline next to field. Server-side validation errors trigger toast + disable submit. Errors clear on input change
Dark Mode: All loading skeletons, error states, empty states must have sufficient contrast in both light and dark themes
Testing Requirements: 80%+ test coverage for new components. axe-core automated scans (0 violations target). Keyboard-only navigation test. Screen reader testing with NVDA/VoiceOver

interface.name: Skeleton Component Props
interface.signature: interface SkeletonProps { width?: string | number; height?: string | number; className?: string; animate?: boolean; }
interface.notes: Reusable skeleton with configurable dimensions and animation. Respects prefers-reduced-motion

interface.name: Toast Hook
interface.signature: const useToast = () => { success: (message: string) => void; error: (message: string) => void; info: (message: string) => void; }
interface.notes: Used throughout app to show notifications. Integrated with API error handler

interface.name: Error Boundary Component
interface.signature: ErrorBoundary wraps components, catches errors, shows fallback UI with Retry button
interface.notes: Three variants: PageErrorBoundary, SectionErrorBoundary, ComponentErrorBoundary. Dev mode shows technical details

interface.name: Confirmation Dialog
interface.signature: ConfirmDialog with title, description, onConfirm, onCancel handlers. Focus trapping, Esc close, keyboard navigation
interface.notes: Used for delete/reset/clear operations. Default focus on Cancel button

interface.name: EmptyState Component
interface.signature: EmptyState with icon, title, description, action button. Different variants for no-data, no-results, error-placeholder
interface.notes: Displayed when data.length === 0 and not loading/error. Distinct visual styling from errors

interface.name: React Query Integration
interface.signature: useQuery/useMutation hooks handle loading/error states. Errors trigger error toast. Retry button in UI calls refetch()
interface.notes: All data fetches use React Query. Error handling middleware maps API errors to user-friendly messages

interface.name: API Error Mapping
interface.signature: mapErrorToMessage(error: Error | APIError): string. Handles network, 4xx, 5xx, timeout errors
interface.notes: Centralized error message mapping. Network error, 401 (session expired), 403 (permission denied), 404 (not found), 429 (rate limited), 500+ (server error), timeout

tests.standards: Testing framework: Jest + React Testing Library for unit/integration tests. Playwright for E2E tests. Accessibility: axe-core for automated a11y scanning (target: 0 violations). Manual screen reader testing (NVDA/VoiceOver) for loading/error announcements. Coverage target: 80%+ for new components (Skeleton, Toast, ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, ErrorBoundary). Patterns: Test component rendering, user interactions (click, keyboard), async state management, accessibility attributes.
tests.locations: nextjs-ui/__tests__/ - Component unit tests nextjs-ui/components/**/*.test.tsx - Co-located component tests nextjs-ui/e2e/ - Playwright E2E tests nextjs-ui/tests/ - Integration tests
tests.ideas:
Unit Tests: - Skeleton: renders with correct dimensions, respects prefers-reduced-motion (static), doesn't announce in accessibility tree - Toast: renders success/error/info types, auto-dismisses after duration, multiple toasts stack correctly (max 3), accessibility attributes present - ConfirmDialog: renders with title/description/buttons, Esc closes dialog, Tab traps focus, default focus on Cancel, onConfirm/onCancel callbacks fire - EmptyState: renders icon/message/button, button callback works, distinct from loading/error states - ErrorBoundary: catches render errors, displays fallback UI, Retry button resets error, dev mode shows technical details
Integration Tests: - API call fails → error toast shows → retry button works → retry succeeds - Form submission fails (client validation) → error message shows inline → user fixes input → error clears - Form submission fails (server validation) → error toast shows + submit disabled → user corrects + retry succeeds - Destructive action → confirmation dialog shows → user cancels → action not executed - Destructive action → confirmation dialog shows → user confirms → action executes
E2E Tests (Playwright): - Page loads → skeleton shows → content loads → skeleton hidden (verify aria-busy removed) - Table sorts/filters → loading indicator shows → data updates → announce "data loaded" - List paginated → page button shows loading state → next page loads → data updates - User navigates away → pending requests cancelled (cleanup) - Dark mode: skeleton has sufficient contrast in dark theme - prefers-reduced-motion: skeleton animation disabled, toast transitions still work
Accessibility Tests: - Keyboard navigation: Tab through all interactive elements, Esc closes modals, Enter activates buttons - Screen reader: "Loading..." announcement on aria-busy, error message announced with role=alert, toast announced with aria-live, empty state message announced - Contrast: all error/loading text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 UI/large) - Focus indicators: visible 2px min, 3:1 contrast on all buttons (Retry, Cancel, Confirm, Close)
